name: Broken Compurhythm
desc: Broken techno on the RolandCompurhythm1000: tresillo-leaning kick that mutates across a 4-cycle alternation, displaced snare answers, ply-stuttered offbeat hats under a slow filter drift, uzu cowbell rotation and doubled-time fills at the 8-bar seam.

code.full: stack(s("<[bd ~ ~ bd ~ ~ bd ~] [bd ~ ~ bd ~ ~ bd ~] [bd ~ ~ bd ~ bd ~ ~] [bd ~ bd ~ ~ bd ~ bd]>").bank("RolandCompurhythm1000").shape(.35).gain(${gain}), s("~ sd ~ [~ sd]").bank("RolandCompurhythm1000").gain(${snap}).room(.2), s("[~ hh]*4").bank("RolandCompurhythm1000").ply("<1 2 1 1>").gain(saw.range(.18, .35).fast(4)).lpf(sine.range(${bright}*.4, ${bright}).slow(32))).orbit(1).play()
code.peak: stack(s("<[bd ~ bd bd ~ ~ bd ~] [bd ~ ~ bd ~ bd bd ~]>").bank("RolandCompurhythm1000").shape(.4).gain(${gain}), s("~ sd ~ [sd ~ ~ sd]").bank("RolandCompurhythm1000").gain(${snap}).room(.2), s("[hh hh]*4").bank("RolandCompurhythm1000").gain(saw.range(.2, .38).fast(4)).lpf(sine.range(${bright}*.5, ${bright}).slow(16)), s("cb(3,16,<2 6 10 14>)").gain(.25)).lastOf(8, x=>x.fast(2)).orbit(1).play()
